set.body: Per decisions q-scope (OD-2) and the session-location resolution on k-framecheck. Validates frame and clock membership on insertion (Either there); accessors are total because membership was proven on the way in. Not forgeable, unlike a capability value. Lives in eyes4s-design -- the earliest module that can see recordings, AOI sets and grids together. Is the project object APP-13's prerequisite query reads from eyes4s-plan.
set.title: Session: checked container with total accessors
